args: $project='${workspaceFolder}/MusicSalesApp/MusicSalesApp.csproj'; $profile='${workspaceFolder}/MusicSalesApp/Properties/PublishProfiles/davidtest - Web Deploy.pubxml'; Write-Host '=== Step 1: Applying EF Migrations ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; dotnet ef database update --project $project --connection 'Server=SQL8011.site4now.net;Database=db_a9f0e0_davidtest;User Id=db_a9f0e0_davidtest_admin;Password=${input:davidTestPassword};TrustServerCertificate=True'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host 'Migration failed!' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }; Write-Host '=== Step 2: Publishing to Web Server ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; dotnet msbuild $project /t:Build,Publish /p:Configuration=Release /p:PublishProfile="$profile" /p:Password=${input:davidTestPassword}; if ($LASTEXITCODE -le 1) { exit 0 }
echo 'These Web Deploy publish profiles are intended for Windows/MSDeploy. Run this task from Windows with pwsh and Visual Studio build tools.' >&2; exit 1

tasks.label: Publish Functions to test (davidtest)
tasks.detail: Publishes the FFmpeg audio-processing Function app to streamtunes-media-test. Resolves func.exe directly, so a stale PATH right after installing Core Tools does not look like 'not installed'.

tasks.label: Publish Functions to production (streamtunes)
tasks.detail: Publishes the FFmpeg audio-processing Function app to streamtunes-media-prod. Resolves func.exe directly, so a stale PATH right after installing Core Tools does not look like 'not installed'.

tasks.label: Sync Function settings (Development)
tasks.detail: Regenerates MusicSalesApp.Functions/local.settings.json from MusicSalesApp/appsettings.Development.json, so the storage connection strings have one source of truth.

tasks.label: Sync Function settings (Test)
tasks.detail: Regenerates MusicSalesApp.Functions/local.settings.json from MusicSalesApp/appsettings.Test.json, so the storage connection strings have one source of truth.

tasks.label: Provision Functions infrastructure (test)
tasks.detail: Creates/updates the streamtunes-media-test Function App. Idempotent; leaves app settings alone once the app exists and only reports drift.

tasks.label: Provision Functions infrastructure (production)
tasks.detail: Creates/updates the streamtunes-media-prod Function App. Idempotent; leaves app settings alone once the app exists and only reports drift.

tasks.label: Check Functions settings drift (test)
tasks.detail: Read-only. Reports any setting where Azure and appsettings.Test.json disagree.
